Reasoning: This stage reaches the non-contact pre-grasp standoff point above cube_2 with the open panda_fingertip. The reach_point target uses cube_2 as the origin, world coordinates for the offset, and [0, 0, 0.125] to keep the fingertip laterally aligned with the cube center while 0.125 m above it; the 0.01 m tolerance encodes the stop distance. The first axis_align makes the tool +z antiparallel to world +z for the top-down approach. The second axis_align makes the tool +y orthogonal to cube_2 +x as the requested box-like finger-axis relation. open_gripper encodes maintaining the gripper open. Individual finger joint command/position monitoring and gripper effort/no-contact feedback are not directly representable with the available operators or condition labels; manipulator_low_effort is not used because it refers to arm/TCP interaction effort, not finger effort. The statement that tool +y is not aligned with tool +z is inherent to the robot frame axes and has no separate operator.
